properties.content:

Suspected Responsible Party: EDDYVILLE CHLOR-ALKALI
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 41.115051, -92.678347 (Approximated from route)
Reported Spill Volume: 200 gallon
Report Description/// THIS IS AN UPDATE TO NRC REPORT 1384685 /// THE UPDATE IS AS FOLLOWS: THE CALLER STATED THAT THEY DISCOVERED (200) GALLONS OF MATERIAL RELEASED DURING THIS INCIDENT. THE CALLER STATED THAT MATERIAL WAS BEING PREPPED TO LOAD A RAIL CAR, WHEN THE FLANGE BROKE WHILE THE RAIL CAR WAS UNDER PRESSURE. BECAUSE OF THIS THE MATERIAL RELEASED FROM THE TOP OF THE RAIL CAR, OPPOSED TO THE ORIGINAL SOURCE WHICH WAS REPORTED AS A STORAGE TANK. THE CALLER STATED THAT THEY PLACED SODA ASH TO CONTAIN THE RELEASE AND NEUTRALIZE THE RELEASED MATERIAL. UPON FURTHER INVESTIGATION MATERIAL NEVER MADE IT TO THE FACILITY’S BASIN, JUST THE STORM DRAIN AT THE LOCATION. /// ORIGINAL REPORT BELOW /// THE CALLER STATED THAT 35% HYDROCHLORIC ACID RELEASED FROM A STORAGE TANK AT A CHEMICAL MANUFACTURING FACILITY. THE MATERIAL RELEASED ONTO A CONTAINMENT SURFACE, AN ONSITE STORM DRAIN, AND THEN INTO A FACILITY BASIN. THE AMOUNT THAT RELEASED IS UNKNOWN, HOWEVER THEY SUSPECT AROUND (1000) GALLONS MAY HAVE RELEASED. THE CAUSE OF THE RELEASE IS STILL UNKNOWN AND UNDER INVESTIGATION.

Report Description
THIS IS AN UPDATED REPORT. PLEASE REFER TO REPORT #943766, 12–JUN-10. CHEVRON CREWS PERFORMING CONSTRUCTION IN RED BUTTE CREEK ENCOUNTERED SOIL THAT APPEARED TO CONTAIN HYDROCARBON CONTAMINATION. THE CREEK HAD PREVIOUSLY BEEN DIVERTED TO ALLOW FOR CONSTRUCTION IN THE STREAMBED. THIS CONSTRUCTION WORK IS PART OF THE ORIGINAL SPILL RESPONSE REQUIRED BY THE UTAH DIVISION OF WATER QUALITY. A SMALL AMOUNT OF SHEEN WAS OBSERVED WHERE GROUNDWATER DAYLIGHTED. CREWS PLACED ABSORBENT MATERIAL TO CONTROL AND COLLECT ANY SHEEN, AND REMOVED IMPACTED SOILS. NO MIGRATION OF SHEEN WAS OBSERVED. ADDITIONAL CONFIRMATION SAMPLING HAS BEEN COORDINATED WITH THE UTAH DIVISION OF WATER QUALITY PERSONNEL WHO WERE ONSITE.
